walkthrough:
Equate the line and curve equations to form a quadratic in $x$:
$$x^2 + bx + 5 = x + 1 \implies x^2 + (b - 1)x + 4 = 0$$

Apply the condition for the line and curve to intersect (at least one real root, $b^2 - 4ac \ge 0$):
$$(b - 1)^2 - 4(1)(4) \ge 0 \implies (b - 1)^2 - 16 \ge 0$$
$$(b - 1)^2 \ge 16$$

Solve the quadratic inequality for $b$:
$$b - 1 \ge 4 \implies b \ge 5$$
$$b - 1 \le -4 \implies b \le -3$$
$$b \le -3 \quad \text{or} \quad b \ge 5$$
